item.title: High court rejects challenge to Maryland gun ban in sensitive places
item.description: The Supreme Court left in place a lower court decision that upheld the measure banning guns in sensitive places.

item.title: Several major U.S. banks reporting widespread service outages
item.description: Customers at Bank of America, JPMorgan Chase and other major banks are reporting widespread service outages. CBS News' Jo Ling Kent reports.

item.title: Major U.S. banks report widespread service outages
item.description: Customers at Bank of America, JPMorgan Chase and other major financial institutions are reporting difficulty accessing their accounts.

item.title: Iran rules out nuclear site inspections until war ends
item.description: Iran says it will not let U.N. inspectors return to assess damaged nuclear sites until the war with the U.S. is "permanently ended."
